title: JBC submits shortlist of chief justice, associate justice candidates to Marcos
summary: The Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) on Thursday submitted to President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. its shortlist of nominees for the position of Supreme Court (SC) chief justice and associate…

blocks.text: The Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) on Thursday submitted to President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. its shortlist of nominees for the position of Supreme Court (SC) chief justice and associate justice.
Based on a letter signed by Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo, five individuals were included in JBC’s shortlist, namely:
This, as two of the five senior SC Justices, Associate Justices Ramon Paul Hernando and Henri Jean Paul Inting, withdrew the acceptance of their respective nominations.
Meanwhile, included in the JBC’s shortlist for associate justice are:

items: Court of Appeals (CA) Associate Justice Ramon Bato Jr.
Commission on Audit Chairperson Gamaliel Cordoba
CA Associate Justice Maria Elisa Sempio Diy
CA Presiding Justice Fernanda Lampas Peralta
Commission on Elections Commissioner Ernesto Maceda Jr.
Court of Tax Appeals Associate Justice Maria Rowena San Pedro

blocks.text: The Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) concluded earlier this week its interviews for the position of Supreme Court chief justice and associate justice.
The vacancies are due to the compulsory retirement of Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo on November 6, and Associate Justice Amy Lazaro-Javier on November 16. — RSJ, GMA News
